dialogues.speaker: Jahan
dialogues.text: What, you never heard of the Anahitian Blessing?

dialogues.speaker: Jahan
dialogues.text: It's practically essential to growing crops, and it's not an overstatement to say it's our savior.

dialogues.speaker: Jahan
dialogues.text: Oh wait, I should say the Dendro Archon is our savior, since the Blessing is a gift from her.

dialogues.speaker: Jahan
dialogues.text: O Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, O Dendro Archon, may you grant us bountiful harvest!
